config.update_rule: payoff-proportional pairwise imitation (copy a random model with prob proportional to its positive payoff gap)
config.fairness: identical PGG params, update rule, init mixing strategy and seeds; the two treatments differ ONLY in whether the Punisher strategy exists

locked_metric: steady-state mean cooperation = fraction contributing (C + P), mean over the last 50 rounds

verdicts.label: P1
verdicts.gate: P1 no-punishment cooperation collapses (steady mean cooperation < 0.20)

verdicts.label: P2
verdicts.gate: P2 with-punishment cooperation sustained (steady mean cooperation > 0.50)

verdicts.label: P3
verdicts.gate: P3 punishment makes the difference (with - without cooperation >= 0.30)
